Messages.Author: Kushiel
Messages.Body:
Can Young Bloods attempt their built-in action if the target is a
vampire with only one blood?

If they can, and the action succeeds, what is its effect?

John Eno

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Kushiel wrote:
> Can Young Bloods attempt their built-in action if the target is a
> vampire with only one blood?

Yes.

> If they can, and the action succeeds, what is its effect?

The target suffers a "burn 2 blood" effect (burning his one blood).
